turns.question: What revenue did customers who signed up in August or September 2024 bring in on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up in August or September 2024 brought in 312.00 EUR of revenue (non-cancelled orders) on 1 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
